goal: Build and validate a minimal enterability classifier prototype for federal contracting sub-segments, extending E220/E221 framework

artifacts.enhanced_prototype: tools/minimal_enterability.py - reversible exploratory prototype classifying NAICS-within-PSC sub-segments as enterable for small programs
artifacts.experiment_results: 19 sub-segments analyzed across 5 IT PSC codes: 5 HIGHLY ENTERABLE, 4 SOMEWHAT ENTERABLE, 5 MARGINAL, 5 CLOSED. Top targets: DA01/541511 (seg_frac=1.000), DA10/541511 (seg_frac=0.478), DA01/541519 (seg_frac=0.364), 7A21/541519 (seg_frac=0.354).
artifacts.multi_year_observation: Multi-year current window (FY2022-2023) framework implemented via --multi-year flag. FY2022 recipient data not in cache; prototype falls back to 2023 data, producing classifications consistent with single-year window. Question of multi-year effect on enterability classifications remains open.
